tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Bright is a white page: cards sit on it separated by border hairlines, not by a tinted ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns and toasts that sit above a surface.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar background, a cool tint just off white with a border hairline on its right edge. muted 5.6:1 on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav item, selected segment, pressed toggle. Never a button fill. ink 14.7:1 on it, primary 4.8:1, muted 4.9:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on bg, surface and accent (≥ 12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, helper text, column headers. 5.4:1 on bg light, 6.5:1 on surface dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only — not enough contrast for a control edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox edges (≥ 3:1 on surface in both themes).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Bright blue. The main button fill, links, the active tab underline, done stages, chart bars. on-primary is 5.7:1 on it.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills; the highlighted bar in a chart.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (5.7:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Море yellow. ONLY the offset shadow under the one main action of a view, and spot-art highlights. Never text, never a status.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Spot-art blob and silhouette colour; chart series 1. Not for text.

tokens.name: sea-light
tokens.usage: Spot-art background blob; avatar and thumbnail tint; the same value as accent in light.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the next-step card (Следваща стъпка, Най-важно сега) and info boxes. muted 5.4:1 on it.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: 1.5px border of the next-step card. Decorative, never a control edge or text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Row or column that needs attention: a property with an active offer, the sorted column in a report. muted 5.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px, offset 2px in the page colour. 5.7:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, destructive actions, field errors. Text-safe on surface and danger-soft (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an overdue pill or error alert.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: At-risk (no next action) icons, bars and pill dots. Light value is 3.8:1 on white: icons and bars only, use warning-ink for text.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text of an at-risk pill or warning alert, on surface or warning-soft (≥ 5:1).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an at-risk pill or warning alert.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Won, answered call, saved. Text-safe on surface and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a won pill or success alert.

families.condensed: "Sofia Sans Semi Condensed", "Sofia Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the Today greeting, an empty-state title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title: a deal, contact or property name.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, notes.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, helper text. Colour muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase overline above a group or field set. Colour muted.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Sofia Sans with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums), so digits line up down a column.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Times, money, phones, m² — anything compared down a column. Tabular figures.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: KPI tiles and the price on a property header. Tabular figures.

groups.name: Dense
groups.note: For wide tables only (Имоти, Отчети), where more columns must fit.

styles.name: cell-dense
styles.usage: Cells of wide tables. Never body text or buttons.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row, between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in dense lists (Today, tables).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top padding, empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and the count bubble only.

shadow.note: Flat: borders separate, shadows lift only what floats. The yellow offset is the system's signature and appears once per view.

tokens.name: shadow-action
tokens.usage: Under the ONE main action of a view (Запиши разговор, Нова сделка). Never on secondary buttons or cards.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Bright is flat: cards on bg use a border hairline and no shadow in light. Dark keeps a faint lift.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, toasts, the post-call sheet.

meta.note: Values are the Bright theme from the design canvas (replacing the Maritime proposal); the code on main still has the stock shadcn theme. See the As built section.
